body.description: Kit, a skinny boy of about twelve, Juno's friend: spiky black hair with teal goggles pushed up on his head, mustard-yellow shirt, tan trousers, a homemade sling in his back pocket, eager talkative grin. a person of a small South Texas border town generations after the sky turned white, sun-faded patched clothes, dust on the boots
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
